remarks: *Highest and Best 5pm Wed* Welcome to 10 Maurice Street, a spacious 2006 colonial on a corner lot in Norwalk. Step into the impressive two-story foyer and find a welcoming open floor plan. A first-floor office/den with bay window features french doors to the family room, which flows to a breakfast area and kitchen. The kitchen includes a pantry, quartz counters with a peninsula, and gas stove with air fryer oven. Sliders open to the deck and spacious side yard with newer vinyl fence. A mudroom connects the kitchen to the attached two-car garage. A formal dining room with bay window, front hall closet, and powder room complete the main floor. Upstairs, the primary suite delivers serious space with walk-in closet and bathroom featuring double vanity, soaking tub, and separate shower. Two additional bedrooms share a full hall bath. The versatile bonus room features a vaulted ceiling will second access via separate staircase - the perfect home gym, playroom, media room, or fourth bedroom. Laundry is conveniently located upstairs near the primary. The basement (garage access) provides utility and storage space. Major updates include 2023 roof, 2024 central AC, 2025 conversion to natural gas heating with tankless water heater, new gas stove, washer and dryer. Corner lot location offers easy highway access, steps to schools, and proximity to SoNo and Westport dining, Calf Pasture Beach, Stew Leonard's, and Whole Foods. Close to East Norwalk train station for Grand Central commuters.
